name: omp-decision-advisor
description: Azure Decision-1 triage with a configurable escalation reviewer and native OMP advisor output

enabled.description: Enable automatic decision scoring and extension escalation reviews; explicit status smoke tests remain available when off.

verbose.description: Show all scoring results, full review JSON and reviewer-request progress; completed reviews use native advisor output.

endpoint.description: Existing Azure AIServices account HTTPS origin; no credentials, paths, query or fragment.

reviewModel.description: Extension reviewer model: OMP advisor role or explicit provider/model selector; not native advisor history.

reviewTools.description: Comma-separated extension reviewer tool grants; blank grants none. Supported: read,grep,glob,recall,lsp,web_search,bash,eval,edit,write,ast_edit,debug. Unavailable selected tools fail explicitly; command/mutation tools are not sandboxed and retain OMP approvals.

reviewInstructions.description: Saved multiline extension reviewer instructions; at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes, with tab/newline/carriage return as the only permitted controls.

reviewHistoryTurns.description: Completed prior review summaries kept in this session (0 disables, at most 8 and 16 KiB total); not persistent native advisor history.

credentialMode.description: Azure CLI identity (az login) or Azure SDK DefaultAzureCredential; credentials are never stored.

passThreshold.description: Required pass probability; lower means fewer reviews, higher is stricter.

timeoutMs.description: Per-turn scoring deadline in milliseconds, including authentication and response reading.

advisorTimeoutMs.description: Reviewer execution deadline in milliseconds; independent of the 20000 ms host wait. Existing saved choices are preserved.
